blocks.title: Sites ready for modular buildings.
blocks.body:
Modular classrooms and portables need a prepared, serviced site before the building arrives. Our crews handle demolition of existing site infrastructure, excavation and grading, utilities and the concrete and paving around the new building.

We have done this work for School District 38 (Richmond) at Brighouse Elementary and on portables across the district, including temporary portables during the seismic upgrade at Howard DeBeck Secondary, and for School District 37 (Delta) at Ladner Elementary.

items.title: Demolition and removal
items.text: Removing existing site infrastructure to make room for the building.

items.title: Site preparation
items.text: Excavation, grading and granular pads for modular buildings and portables.

items.title: Retaining and drainage
items.text: Lock-block retaining walls and perforated drain pipe around the building.

items.title: Utilities
items.text: Storm and sanitary sewer, fire and domestic water, and duct trenches for power.

items.title: Paving
items.text: Asphalt overlay and new paving at parking areas and school yards.

items.q: Do you prepare sites for modular classrooms?
items.a: Yes. We have prepared and serviced sites for modular classrooms and portables for School District 38 (Richmond) and School District 37 (Delta).

items.q: Can you work while the school is open?
items.a: Yes. At Howard DeBeck Secondary we built the site for temporary portables that kept classes running during the seismic upgrade. See [School site works](school-site-works.html).

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Send drawings or a tender package to info@nscltd.ca or call 604-644-5884.

blocks.title: Adding modular classrooms?
blocks.text: Send drawings, a tender package or a prequalification request. Our estimating team will respond within one business day.
